catalyst: Shipping attacks in Strait of Hormuz and Hurricane Isaias continuing to limit Gulf output
invalidation_criteria: OPEC+ announces increased output or Gulf production resumes to pre‑hurricane levels, or shipping attacks cease and Hormuz flows normalize, pushing price below $90
monitoring_horizon: Next 3‑5 days for hurricane track and attack reports; OPEC meeting this week
